name: Hypnosis : Quiet Nights
detailed_description:
A narrative-driven psychological exploration game combining dialogue and side-scrolling action.

At the boundary between dreams and reality, save a mind on the verge of collapse.

【Story Overview】

You will accompany Ella, a girl suffering from severe insomnia and nervous exhaustion.
As night falls, anxiety and loneliness creep in like shadows. Through companionship and choices, can you help her survive the hardest moments of her life?

Through conversations, choices, and exploration, you will gradually uncover the cracks in Ella's heart and step into her unpredictable dream world.

Should she take the pill？

【Main Gameplay & Features】

Narrative Dialogue

  • Engage in deep conversations with Ella to uncover her past and inner struggles.

  • Your words and choices will influence Ella’s emotions and mental state.

  • Multiple narrative branches and endings determine the course of her fate.

Dreamscape Challenges

  • Once asleep, dive into 2D side-scrolling action stages within the dream world.

  • Explore surreal dreamscapes: crumbling city ruins, the twisted Dreamcore Amusement Park, claustrophobic castles, eerie hospitals, and more.

  • Combines combat and puzzle-solving, with each dream featuring unique mechanics and hidden secrets.

Combat & Growth

  • Control dream-world Ella and fight off lurking “cute yet unsettling” monsters.

  • Unlock special skills and grow stronger to face increasingly powerful nightmares.

  • Every sleep brings different dreams — high replay value with rich exploration.

Mental State System

  • Ella’s mood, anxiety levels, and sleep quality dynamically affect the dream world and its difficulty.

  • Your choices and actions in both reality and dreams shape her psychological trajectory.

  • Switch between “real-world dialogue” and “dream challenges” to influence the ultimate outcome.

【Additional Information】

  • Single-player | 2D Side-scrolling Action + Interactive Narrative | Psychological Exploration Theme.

  • Estimated Playtime: 6–12 hours, including multiple endings and hidden content.

  • Original soundtrack designed to immerse players in the intertwined atmosphere of dreams and reality.

  • No graphic violence — blends cute and eerie aesthetics, perfect for fans of story-driven and psychological games.

In the endless drift between sleep and wakefulness…

May your presence guide her to the gentlest future.

May you have a quiet night.

short_description: A psychological exploration game combining dialogue and side-scrolling action. Guide a sleepless girl through a journey of dreams, medication, and fragile emotions. Enter her dreams, battle adorable yet dangerous creatures, and gently change the course of her fate.

English*, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
